## Products & Professional Services Catalog (`products.html`)
URL: https://nugrohoamdalportfolio.dpdns.org/products.html

### Products & Professional Services
This section serves as the unified catalog combining production AI applications, digital toolkits, enterprise B2B corporate training, and lifetime career mentorship:

- **End-to-End Automated HRIS & Payroll Architecture (27-Sheet System)**: Zero-macro automated Indonesian HR & Payroll system built by Nugroho Amdal. Covers PPh 21 TER (PP 58/2023) & Pasal 17 year-end reconciliation, BPJS caps, pro-rata calculations, PKWT 5-year alerts, PP 35/2021 severance calculator, 33 automated internal audit rules (Cek Data), and a 20-KPI Executive Dashboard.
- **Automated Recruitment & Manpower Planning (MPP) Hub (10-Module System)**: Zero-macro end-to-end recruitment & ATS engine built by Nugroho Amdal. Connects annual Manpower Planning (MPP), Requisition approvals, working-day SLA/TAT monitoring with early warning alerts, consent-compliant Talent Pool database, dynamic candidate search, and 1-click WhatsApp/Email interview invitation generator.
- **Employee Value Proposition (EVP) Analytics & Culture Diagnostic**: End-to-end Google Sheets & Apps Script diagnostic engine built by Nugroho Amdal to measure Credibility Gap (management claim vs employee reality), Evidence Gap (SOP readiness), Give-Get Ratio, Voice of Employee (VoE), 90-day impact simulation, and Priority Action Scores for executive retention decisions.

1. **Career Clarity App (AI Web Application):**
   - AI-powered ATS CV generator and resume diagnostic platform engineered to bypass automated ATS filters.
   - Link: https://careerclarity-app.vercel.app/
   - Features: Deterministic ATS Keyword Match Scoring, Actionable Competency Gap Fixes, Role Fit Analysis.

2. **Talent Up Career Acceleration Bootcamp (Career Mentorship):**

   - Features: Weekly 1-on-1 CV/LinkedIn Audits, Live Mock Interviews with Global HR, Hiring Manager Referral Network.

3. **Job Apply AI (Productivity Engine):**
   - Web application delivering instant tailored cover letters, centralized application pipeline tracking, and recruiter outreach templates.
   - Features: Contextual Cover Letters, Multi-Company Job Tracker, LinkedIn Outreach Generator.

4. **HR Operations & KPI Starter Bundle (Digital Product Toolkit):**

## Featured Stories & Case Studies (`stories.html`)
URL: https://nugrohoamdalportfolio.dpdns.org/stories.html

### 1. End-to-End Automated HRIS, PPh 21 TER & Payroll Architecture (27-Sheet Zero-Macro System)
- **Context:** Indonesian HR and Finance teams face complex regulations: PPh 21 TER (PP 58/2023) across Categories A, B, C, progressive Article 17 reconciliation on month 12 / employee terminations, dynamic BPJS caps, manual leave tracking fragmentation, and security risks from macro/VBA files blocked by IT policies.
- **Solution:** Built an end-to-end, 100% zero-macro automated HRIS & Payroll spreadsheet engine spanning 27 interconnected sheets. Features single-entry leave logging synced directly to attendance and payroll, effective work-day pro-rata math, automated PPh 21 TER with automatic year-end Article 17 adjustment, PP 35/2021 severance & compensation calculator, PKWT 5-year legal threshold alerts, 33 automated internal audit rules (Cek Data), treasury cash outflow forecasting, and a 20-KPI Executive Dashboard.
- **Impact:**
  - 100% calculation accuracy with zero macro security vulnerabilities.
  - Slashed payroll calculation and verification cycles from days to minutes.
  - Single source of truth eliminates duplicate entries across leave logs, attendance registers, and payroll.
  - Complete compliance with Indonesian labor law and tax authority regulations.

### 2. Zero-Cost LMS & Deterministic Automation for 500+ Staff Across 26 Countries
- **Context:** Managing remote operations and cross-border team onboarding across 26 countries without high recurring per-seat SaaS costs.
- **Solution:** Designed and deployed a zero-cost LMS using Google Workspace infrastructure, Google Apps Script, and automated webhooks for TEI Recruitment.
- **Impact:**
  - Managed 100+ international trainees and 5-7 trainers simultaneously.
  - Lifted talent retention rate by +30%.
  - Zero recurring third-party software licensing overhead.

### 3. Mobile Performance Evaluation App (Apple App Store & Google Play Store)
- **Context:** Manual monthly performance evaluations across multiple educational branches took 48 hours to collect, calculate, and compile into leaderboards.
- **Solution:** Developed an internal mobile app published to Google Play Store and Apple App Store for real-time peer and superior appraisals.
- **Impact:**
  - Slashed compilation cycle from 48 hours to 15-30 minutes semi-realtime.
  - Transparent KPIs boosted team trust and accountability.
  - Awarded *Best HR of the Year 2023* (Mr. BOB Kampung Inggris).

### 4. Mentoring 150+ Aviation Cadets at Aeronef Academy & Jogja Flight
- **Context:** Cabin crew recruitment requires impeccable grooming, English fluency under pressure, and flawless behavioral presentation.
- **Solution:** Integrated BNSP Level 4 instructional methodology with rigorous mock interview panels and Aviation English pronunciation drills.
- **Impact:**
  - 150+ cadets successfully prepared for domestic and international airline recruitment drives (Garuda Indonesia, Lion Air Group, Citilink, AirAsia, Emirates, Qatar Airways).

### 5. Scaling Talent Up to 1,000+ Job Seekers & Professionals
- **Context:** Millions of graduates struggle with ATS filters and unstructured interview responses.
- **Solution:** Combined deterministic algorithmic scoring with personalized human feedback through Career Coach AI and intensive cohort bootcamps.
- **Impact:**
  - 1,000+ professionals and fresh graduates coached.
  - Average interview invitation rate increased from 8% to 42% within 30 days post-mentorship.

### 6. Beating ATS Screening with Career Clarity App
- **Context:** Fresh graduates and job seekers frequently face automatic rejections because standard resumes fail algorithmic ATS parsing.
- **Solution:** Career Clarity App (https://careerclarity-app.vercel.app/) uses Generative AI to diagnose keyword gaps and align resumes with global recruiter criteria.
- **Impact:** Eliminates ATS rejections and multiplies interview callback opportunities. Proven by user testimonials to act like an industry insider providing highly detailed and realistic career path advice beyond standard CV formatting.

### 7. Layoff Recovery & Landing Global Remote Jobs via Talent Up Mentorship
- **Context:** Economic downturn and "tech winter" left seasoned workers and career switchers battling hiring age limits in domestic markets.
- **Solution:** Talent Up Career Development (https://talentup.myscalev.com/careerdevelopment) offers pay-once, lifetime access mentorship teaching multinational remote hiring secrets, STAR framing, and global outreach.
- **Impact:** 1,000+ alumni guided to cross-border remote and on-site dream roles. Backed by video testimonials of candidates landing jobs in under 2 months, accelerating from zero interviews to rejecting multiple job offers.

### 8. Corporate HR Recruitment Optimization (Webinar)
- **Corporate HR Recruitment Optimization (Webinar)**: Masterclass on implementing data-driven marketing funnels and automation (ATS) to cure recruiter burnout, cut time-to-hire, and drastically improve candidate quality. (Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Kr0CY9W23MY)

### 9. 1-on-1 Executive English Coaching
- **1-on-1 Executive English Coaching**: Advanced communication mentorship for C-levels and Division Heads (e.g., Injourney Airports). Eliminates speaking blocks by teaching Executive Presence, diplomatic hedging, and strategic frameworks (BLUF, STAR) for global stakeholder negotiations. (Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b1gLleMLfg8)
